plan_point: 77.44 / WEB-011 -> 77.44.7.D / EDT-042 adjacent diagnostics security regression
defect: The previous preboot source sanitizer stripped origins/queries for HTTP URLs but parsed non-HTTP schemes as paths. A data: filename can contain arbitrary inline source text; a blob: filename can reveal its embedded location. Both could therefore expose payload data in early diagnostics.

implementation.scheme_policy: Only HTTP and HTTPS source locations retain a bounded path. All other explicit URI schemes are reduced to <scheme>:[redacted], before URL parsing.
implementation.regression: Real Chromium emits data:text/javascript,raw-data-source-secret and blob:https://cdn.example.invalid/raw-blob-source-secret filenames and verifies neither payload reaches stored diagnostics or console output.
implementation.bounds: Retains at most 100 early events, 320 characters per message, and no raw Error or target object.
implementation.invariants: No change to page model, Save, Publish, API, production D1 or R2 behavior.

targeted_browser.result: 3/3 real Chromium tests passed; includes HTTP/query/raw Error redaction, data:/blob: source-payload redaction, queue/message bounds, and failed Save draft preservation/retry.

queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS migration_count, MAX(name) AS latest_migration FROM d1_migrations

Save and Publish remain separate.
